meta.title: Data Intelligence for Agencies – dynamiq.
meta.description: Custom data collection, research and analysis for agencies. Project-based or continuous, behind the scenes or completely white label.

hero.heading: You have the client question.
hero.lead: Your clients want to understand what is happening across platforms, communities and the open web.
hero.text: dynamiq. helps agencies answer those questions with structured data collection, analysis and actionable intelligence.
hero.note: An extension of your team. Project-based, behind the scenes or completely white label.

brief.label: From question to intelligence
brief.question: What are customers complaining about that our surveys are missing?
brief.footer: Your client. Your brand. Our research.

questions.heading: Go beyond
questions.intro: Most monitoring tools are good at counting mentions. They are less useful when the real question is:
items: What do customers actually complain about?
Which communities, accounts or platforms are driving a topic?
What signals are traditional monitoring tools missing?
questions.outro: dynamiq. investigates the data behind those questions.

research.heading: Research infrastructure.
research.intro: We combine custom data collection, platform research and quantitative analysis to turn fragmented public information into usable intelligence.

items.title: Social & Community Research
items.text: Analyse posts, comments and discussions across relevant platforms and communities. Understand what people are talking about — and why.

items.title: Narrative Analysis
items.text: Identify recurring narratives, themes, claims and emerging discussion patterns. Track how they develop across platforms and over time.

items.title: Consumer Insights
items.text: Find pain points, unmet needs, questions, product feedback and purchasing signals directly in public conversations.

items.title: Competitive Intelligence
items.text: Analyse competitors, products, positioning and customer reactions using public data.

items.title: Issue & Reputation Intelligence
items.text: Understand which topics are emerging around a company, brand or industry before they become obvious in aggregate dashboards.

items.title: Custom Data Research
items.text: Have a question that does not fit into an existing dashboard? We can build the dataset around the question.

partnership.heading: Your external data
partnership.intro: You do not need another dashboard. You need answers you can use in strategy decks, client meetings and recommendations.

items.title: White label
items.text: We can deliver analyses without dynamiq. branding so you can integrate the work directly into your own client deliverables.

items.title: Project-based
items.text: No long procurement process or permanent tool subscription required. Bring us a research question and we build the analysis around it.

items.title: Methodologically transparent
items.text: We document sources, collection methods, assumptions and limitations so your team can understand and defend the findings.

items.title: Custom instead of one-size-fits-all
items.text: We are not limited to the metrics available in a standard SaaS dashboard. If the data can be collected responsibly from public sources, we can investigate it.

items.title: You bring the question
questions: Why is sentiment around our client’s product changing?
Which topics dominate discussions around our competitors?
What are customers complaining about that our surveys are missing?
Which narratives are emerging around this industry?

cases.heading: Questions from
cases.intro: From a focused pitch question to a complex communications challenge.

items.title: PR & Communications
items.question: A client is suddenly facing criticism on TikTok, Reddit or YouTube.
items.text: We analyse where it started, which themes are spreading and what is driving the discussion.

items.title: Brand Strategy
items.question: Your team wants to understand how consumers actually describe a category, product or competitor.
items.text: We identify recurring language, needs, frustrations and associations.

items.title: Corporate Communications
items.question: A topic is developing across platforms but traditional monitoring provides little context.
items.text: We reconstruct the underlying conversation and its dynamics.

items.title: Consumer Insights
items.question: Surveys tell you what customers say when asked. Public conversations show what they talk about without being asked.
items.text: We help analyse both sides of that picture.

items.title: Competitive Intelligence
items.question: You want to understand how customers compare several competitors.
items.text: We analyse public discussions, reviews, comments and platform activity around them.

items.title: Pitch & New Business
items.question: Need a strong data point for a pitch?
items.text: We can run focused research around a market, audience or topic and provide original findings your competitors are unlikely to have.

engagements.heading: One research question.
engagements.intro: You do not need to start with a large engagement.

items.title: Signal Scan
items.text: A focused analysis of one question, market or topic.
items.fit: Pitches, client workshops and initial investigations.

items.title: Deep Dive
items.text: A larger research project combining custom data collection and analysis.
items.fit: Strategic projects, market research and complex communications questions.

items.title: Continuous Intelligence
items.text: Ongoing monitoring and analysis of selected signals, platforms, competitors or topics.
items.fit: Continuous visibility rather than a one-off snapshot.

relationship.heading: Your client relationship
paragraphs: We can work visibly alongside your team or completely in the background. You remain the strategic partner.
dynamiq. provides the data infrastructure, research and analysis behind the scenes.
points: No unnecessary layer between you and your client.
relationship.signature: The source changes. The pipeline stays.
